lsm-tree vs RocksDB

Every engine runs the same workload in one process on one host, so a chart compares engines, not hosts. Bars are the mean time per operation (lower is faster) at each key count; the tooltip shows the 95% confidence interval. Both engines get the same block size, bloom filter, block cache and values, no WAL, and every lsm-tree protection RocksDB has no equivalent for is off. · single-engine trend →
